name: checkout-one-time-payments
why: Stripe's own sample for one-time Checkout payments: an Express server with plain HTML, next to servers in six other languages.

name: with-stripe-typescript
why: Vercel's official Next.js App Router example: hosted and embedded Checkout, Elements, and a webhook route.

name: accept-a-payment
why: Stripe's sample with several apps in one repository: prebuilt Checkout and custom card forms, in many languages.

name: nextjs-subscription-payments
why: A popular Next.js SaaS starter. Its checkout (a server action) sells subscriptions and one-time prices, so Portage plans PayPal for the one-time payments and leaves subscriptions on Stripe.

name: saas-starter
why: The Next.js SaaS starter (Drizzle, Postgres): subscriptions through Checkout and the customer portal.
